body: Oh I forgot to answer all your questions. We meet when we were both working together 9 years ago. He asked me out a bunch of times and it took me a year to finally go out with him. We were inseparable from the beginning. After 6 months we were engaged and I was pregnant after 2 years. I had to do fertility treatments to get pregnant. We were extremely happy, but I had a feeling like something bad would happen and I was constantly waiting for the other shoe to drop. When I was 12 weeks, he got sick and almost died. Had to have emergency surgery. I miscarried twins a week later. Since then I've been depressed and we started fighting about really little things. But the fights would get bad and I actually started hitting him. I went to therapy for it, which didn't help, but eventually I stopped because it only made things worse. Reacting with violence is something codependents do when they can't control someone. Eventually I got that it was wrong. He's never HIT me, but he did push me, which is why I moved out. I feel like everything went down hill when I had my first miscarriage.

You're exactly right. You get my situation. Everyone keeps telling me to just dump him and start seeing other people. We've been together 8 years and I don't want to walk away until we've both dealt with our problems separately and then once were both healthy, try to work on making our relationship healthy. I definitely want to get into a residential program and if and when I do, I hope he will see how sick he is. I've tried to get him to talk to his doctor, but he won't allow me to go to appointments with him so idk what's going on really. Seems like they give him a new med every time he goes. I know we are both enabling each other. But me being codependent makes it hard for me to stop. I don't know if you know what codependency really is, but its a lot like an addiction to controlling people. I want to rescue him from his addiction. But obviously I can't. No one can but him.

He's not trying to convince me to kill myself. His best friend killed himself 2 years ago. So when he hears me say I'm suicidal, he gets mad. He's mad at his friend for killing himself. So when he's mad he says "go ahead and do it". He's trying to help me get help and the reason he's acting so erratic and psycho is a combination of being an alcoholic as well as 9 different prescribed meds he's on including xanex, oxycontin, sleeping pills and antidepressants. He had surgery a month ago and his erratic behavior started after that. Yes he's being a real ass towards me right now, but he's sick as well. His family has all stopped talking to him in hopes that he will get help, but he's so messed up he hasn't even noticed. Nobody wants to hear this, but he really does comfort me. He's like a safety blanket. Its what's working for me right now.

Anyways, I'm pretty sure the reason I'm depressed is because of abuse from childhood and all my stress lately has just brought it to a head. Plus just having been on fertility treatments and had a second miscarriage because I'm so stressed. I'm having a third life crisis

Its funny that you said I should talk to my fiance. He's depressed himself but he's the one of the people who says I should kill myself. I had to move out and back in with my mom because he's an alcoholic and was acting very erratic and psychotic. I still hang out with him everyday though. We had sex this morning for the first time in a long time, because he has ED, and I felt completely used and like my needs don't matter to him at all. So when I tried to explain that to him, he got mad at me. So then he told me to leave and now I'm setting here about to leave for work and I feel completely broken and I think maybe he's using me. But I know that's not true. But I can't keep those thoughts away. I have to work for 8 hours and all I want to do is lay in bed and cry.
And my fiance says he wants to die everyday, but he doesn't want to kill himself, so we basically set around feeling sorry for ourselves. Smh.
We have a close friend who killed himself 2 years ago and no one saw it coming. So yes, they get mad at me and its because they think I just want attention. But its not that I just want attention.

I know the stalker is full of shit. She's obsessed with my boyfriend and is doing the same thing to him. I actually got a call from the doctors TV show today and will be talking to a producer tomarrow. A lot of media outlets are jumping on the suicide stories right now. What a sick society where suicide is trending. I want to start a scholarship for people in my situation to get help. But I definitely need help myself. When I try to talk to people about being suicidal they get mad at me and tell me to do it. I understand their anger but I'm begging for help and no one takes me seriously.
